question: Does FilmLabPro's current Published Film Data page provide a reusable paired-pixel or explicitly licensed measured-data source for the Velvia 50, Portra 400 and Ektar 100 programme?
scientific_role: A current secondary implementation/reconnaissance lead showing which manufacturer datasheet quantities can seed bounded stock priors. It is not a paired target corpus, an independently calibrated stock-response measurement, or an admissible implementation source.
allowed_followup: Use only the cited first-party manufacturer publications already independently bound in RF3.D2-RF3.D6, and continue the project-owned SF3.A0L/A0N controlled capture route.
forbidden_followup: treating the Open Data label as an open licence
using the page as photographic RGB ground truth
purchasing a product or service without separate authorization
next_mainline: No further web-source expansion on this lead. Populate the frozen rights-cleared three-stock capture packet and run SF3.A1 -> SF3.A2 -> SF3.A4 -> SF3.A5 when real observations arrive; otherwise advance only deterministic product-core work that does not fabricate stock evidence.
claim_ceiling: Bounded current web-source and rights finding only; no reuse permission, copied numeric dataset, operator, pixels, stock response, calibration, preference, product admission or completed multi-stock system.
